lead.claim: Which measures help predict falls in older adults with multiple sclerosis?
lead.context: Why this matters: This study evaluated associations between patient-reported and objective measures of mobility with prospective falls in older adults with multiple sclerosis.

supporting.claim: Lower limb motor recovery after cervical SCI is not uniform.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study investigated the recovery trajectories of lower limb motor function following cervical spinal cord injury.

supporting.claim: How can school-based physical activity programs succeed in disadvantaged areas?
supporting.context: Why this matters: This narrative review identified factors for effective school-based physical activity programs in socio-economically disadvantaged contexts in high-income countries.
